slots.root: fixed inset-0 z-modal-nested flex items-center justify-center bg-scrim backdrop-blur-scrim
slots.panel: w-115 max-w-[92vw] bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface shadow-surface-deep overflow-hidden
slots.head: px-floating-x pt-5.5
slots.eyebrow: font-face-eyebrow text-eyebrow tracking-eyebrow case-eyebrow mb-2 font-eyebrow
slots.title: font-face-heading font-heading text-title-section text-ink-heading tracking-heading leading-heading
slots.body: px-floating-x py-floating-y font-body text-md leading-prose text-ink-body/(--level-ink-body)
slots.requireLabel: font-face-label text-ctl-xs tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) mb-1.5

slots.foot: flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2.5 px-floating-x pb-5.5
slots.confirm: inline-flex items-center justify-center h-ctl-h px-4.5 rounded-control border-[length:var(--bw-control)] border-transparent font-body font-control text-ctl cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-45 disabled:cursor-not-allowed gap-control transition-[background,box-shadow] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover hover:shadow-control-raised shadow-control-rest outline-none focus-visible:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
